## gitshift ui

Open the interactive terminal interface

### Synopsis

Open GitShift's keyboard-driven terminal interface.

The UI manages accounts, validated switching, directory rules, and explicit
discovery imports. Unsafe force options and key generation remain CLI-only.
Both input and output must be attached to a terminal.

```
gitshift ui [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help     help for ui
      --inline   render below the current terminal content instead of using the alternate screen
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string   config file (default is $HOME/.config/gitshift/config.yaml)
```
